messages:
Alice M: Heads-up — planning a small route-weight squeeze for EU edge tonight 02:00 UTC. Goal: shift 10% more traffic to eu-west for perf experiments. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks? quick rollback plan needed.
Ben P: I can run the deploy. will be on-call during the window. ETA 02:00–02:15 UTC.
Eva: I’ll watch canaries and metrics (latency, 5xx, error budgets). I’ll post sigs to watch.
Ciara: Quick Q — what TTLs are we using and how do we apply the weights? we should avoid a big TTL change.
Ben P: TTL stays at 30s for route assets, using weighted routing in our traffic config. plan: increment weight by 5% every 5m until +10%.
Alice M: Nice. Smoke checklist (short): 1) deploy config push, 2) canary routing change, 3) synthetic user flow smoke, 4) validate KV cache hit-rate, 5) rollback if error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m.
Eva: Adding metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, token-per-request cost spike, 5xx count, autoscale events. I’ll set a grafana panel and a short alert rule.
Ciara: Can we add a pre-deploy dry-run to preview route changes? like `redwoodctl route plan --region eu --delta 10`
Ben P: Yep, will run `redwoodctl route plan` then `redwoodctl route apply --batch 5 --wait 300s`. I’ll paste the dry-run output in thread before applying.
DeployBot: scheduled task created by Ben P — route-weight-squeeze-eu — start 02:00 UTC — dry-run at 01:55 UTC.
Alice M: Rollback plan: revert weights to baseline and kick instant cache flush for edge config. Ben, do you have the script ready?
Ben P: I have rollback script: `scripts/rollback-eu-weights.sh` — it sets weights back and clears the config cache. I’ll test locally beforehand.
Eva: If anything looks off I’ll cut at the next 5m step and trigger rollback. will also coordinate with SRE if traffic anomalies appear.
Ciara: FYI I’ll monitor DNS propagation view to ensure the weighted changes are visible, and confirm no unexpected region bleed.
Alice M: Great. Final ask: whoever is on deploy, drop the dry-run output + the exact `redwoodctl` commands here. I’ll be available for coordination. :thumbsup:
Ben P: Will do. dry-run scheduled at 01:55 UTC, live at 02:00 UTC. ping me in this thread when ready.
Eva: I’ll post the grafana link ~01:50 UTC and attach the alert runbook.
DeployBot: dry-run completed by Ben P at 1962345755 — no blocking diffs detected.
Ben P: Applying step 1 -> +5% now. posting logs: `apply: step 1/2, delta +5% -> ok`
Eva: Canary metrics look stable first 5m. p95 +12ms, 5xx 0. Confirm continuing to step 2 in 5m.
Ben P: Applying step 2 -> final +5%. `apply: step 2/2, delta +5% -> ok`
Alice M: Thanks team — monitoring for 15m then closing. If rollback is needed, call it in this thread and Ben will run `scripts/rollback-eu-weights.sh`. :raised_hands:
